name: expense-api
description: Owns expense claims and the employee reporting hierarchy. Creates a claim for the signed-in employee, lists the caller's own claims, lists the claims of the caller's direct reports, and lets a manager approve or reject a direct report's claim. Refuses to create a claim the receipt reader flagged as gambling/betting. Does not read receipts or call any model itself — expense-webapp calls receipt-reader directly and sends this service only the (possibly corrected) extracted fields.
